headline: HuyenBao v11.24 — market finally moves + Finance/Assets split + 16 new items + 3D nav + event/notification fixes
summary: Structural + bugfix pass. (1) MARKET FIXED — the real bug behind 'market chưa hoạt động': STOCKS[].vol was defined but never used and s.hist was never pushed to, so prices only moved on year-boundary shocks/crises and sparklines were dead flat lines. Stocks now do a daily geometric random walk (30s per game-day) scaled by each stock's volatility (COIN ±9% … BANK ±2%) with gentle mean reversion toward the listing price (clamped 0.25×–6×), and history is appended (capped 60 points) so charts finally move. (2) EVENTS/NOTIFICATIONS FIXED — the real bug behind 'thông báo và hint sự kiện vẫn chưa hoạt động': the day>30 threshold meant 15 minutes of real play before the FIRST AI-oracle popup or ambient toast could ever roll; most sessions ended before anything fired. Threshold lowered day>30 → day>3 (~90 seconds). Rates unchanged (9%/day oracle, 6%/day ambient). (3) WHAT'S-NEW REPEAT FIXED — the modal key was per-patch (tycoon_seen_v11.21/.22/.23) so every version bump re-showed the SAME static v11 feature list ('big update bị lặp lại'); now keyed once per major version (tycoon_seen_v11). Also removed the reload-banner button that wiped the seen flag. (4) NAV REORGANIZED — 'Portfolio' group split into two: 'Tài sản' (Assets — the diversified item catalogue) and 'Tài chính' (Finance — Markets + Banking). Physical possessions and financial instruments are different mental models. (5) 16 NEW ITEMS in 5 new categories: Sneakers (Jordan 1, Yeezy, Dior B23, Nike Air Mag, LV×Nike AF1), Handbag (Coach Tabby, LV Neverfull, Chanel Classic Flap, Hermès Birkin), Audio (McIntosh stack, gramophone), Camera (Leica M11, Hasselblad 907X), Classic car (BMW M3 E30, Porsche 959, Mercedes 300SL Gullwing). Grail pieces appreciate (Air Mag +10%/yr, Birkin +12%/yr — mirroring real collector markets). 3 new SVG icons (sneaker, handbag, camera). Catalog now 67 items / 16 categories. (6) 3D ANIMATED NAV — buttons lift on hover with perspective rotateX tilt (Level 1) or scale pop (Level 2), press down on :active; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Version bumped to v11.24. 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features unchanged.
